conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Hello. Could you tell me your age and gender, and what brings you in today?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: I'm 35 years old and male. I'm here because I've been having some pain on the inside of my right elbow, and it's been making it hard to do things like lift or use my arm normally. It started about four days ago, and it's been getting worse.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you please provide your age, gender, and describe the nature of the pain in your right elbow, including any associated symptoms?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: I'm 35 years old and male. The pain is on the inside of my right elbow, and it's been making it hard to lift or use my arm normally. It started about four days ago and has been getting worse. It doesn't go into my shoulder, but it can go down a bit into my forearm, and it keeps me up at night.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Have you experienced any recent trauma, repetitive movements, or activities that could have caused this elbow pain? Additionally, have you had any prior injuries or surgeries to the elbow or forearm?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: No, I haven't had any recent trauma or injuries to my elbow. I was doing a lot of pottery during the pandemic, and I think that's what caused the pain. I've never injured that elbow before.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you describe the nature of the pain (e.g., sharp, dull, burning) and whether it is associated with any specific movements or activities?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: The pain feels more like a dull ache, but it can get sharp when I move my wrist or try to lift things. It's especially bad when I try to turn my wrist inward or when I flex my wrist against resistance. It really bothers me when I try to do pottery or use my arm for anything heavy.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you describe any swelling, redness, or warmth around the elbow? Have you noticed any numbness or tingling in your forearm or hand?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: I don't notice any swelling, redness, or warmth around the elbow, and I haven't had any numbness or tingling in my forearm or hand.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you describe any tenderness or specific areas of pain in your elbow? Also, have you had any previous elbow issues or surgeries?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: There's tenderness on the inside of my elbow, especially around the medial epicondyle. I don't remember having any previous issues with my elbow or any surgeries.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Could you describe any specific movements or activities that make the pain worse, and have you noticed any swelling, redness, or numbness in the elbow or forearm?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: The pain gets worse when I turn my wrist inward or when I flex my wrist against resistance, like when I'm doing pottery. I don't notice any swelling, redness, or numbness in my elbow or forearm.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Have you had any recent imaging or lab tests for your elbow, such as an X-ray or MRI?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: No, I haven't had any recent imaging or lab tests for my elbow. The doctor did an X-ray, and I was told there was no fracture or bony abnormality, but I don't remember anything else about it.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Have you noticed any weakness in your grip or difficulty fully extending your elbow? Also, does the pain improve with rest or worsen with specific activities?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: I haven't noticed any weakness in my grip or difficulty extending my elbow fully. The pain does improve a little with rest, but it definitely gets worse when I do activities like pottery, especially when I'm using my wrist a lot.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Have you noticed any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your fingers or hand, especially on the side of the right arm?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: No, I haven't noticed any numbness, tingling, or weakness in my fingers or hand on the right side. The pain is mainly focused on my elbow and forearm, and I haven't had any issues with my fingers or hand.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Have you noticed any swelling, redness, or warmth around your right elbow or forearm?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: No, I haven't noticed any swelling, redness, or warmth around my right elbow or forearm. The pain is mainly focused on the inside of my elbow and can go down a bit into my forearm, but there's no swelling or redness that I can see.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Have you experienced any numbness or tingling in your fingers or hand, especially on the side of your right arm?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: No, I haven't experienced any numbness or tingling in my fingers or hand, especially on the side of my right arm. The pain is mainly focused on the inside of my elbow and can go down a bit into my forearm, but there's no numbness or tingling that I can feel.

conversation_turns.speaker: Doctor
conversation_turns.text: Have you noticed any weakness in your grip or difficulty extending your elbow fully?

conversation_turns.speaker: Patient
conversation_turns.text: No, I haven't noticed any weakness in my grip or difficulty extending my elbow fully. The pain is there, but I can still move my elbow and use my arm, though it's uncomfortable when I do things like pottery.
